research.periods: Nested cumulative intervals, beginning January 1 of each stated year; not disjoint cohorts.
research.sampling: Filter the same globally selected crossing events by signal date. Preserve previous cooldown across start boundaries; do not create a new event merely because a period starts.
research.reference: Next trading day close, then 5/20/60 trading days.
research.uncertainty: 5000 natural-year cluster bootstrap replicates within each period; seed 20261005+start year. Exploratory, unadjusted for multiple comparisons. Degenerate all-success/all-failure bootstrap intervals are not reliable; Wilson intervals are supplementary approximate binomial bounds and do not account for regime dependence.
research.state_sampling: Exclusive left-closed, right-open bins, daily overlapping mature observations.
